usedFor: Webinargeek holds webinar registrations and viewers, Youtube Transcript pulls transcripts, and “New Registration” can start “Generate Video Transcripts”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Webinargeek, then “Generate Video Transcripts” in Youtube Transcript
bestTemplate.why: Each webinar signup starts a transcript job for the videos you name.

watchOut: “New Registration” in Webinargeek is polling, so “Generate Video Transcripts” starts after a short delay.
